run_fused_moe_lora: run fused MoE LoRA inference by executing the shrink-then-expand kernel pipeline on hidden states
run_fused_moe_lora_shrink: run the shrink phase of fused MoE LoRA to project hidden states through LoRA A weights
run_fused_moe_lora_expand: run the expand phase of fused MoE LoRA to project intermediate activations through LoRA B weights
run_fused_moe_lora_kernel: run the Triton JIT kernel for grouped GEMM with expert routing and LoRA adapter selection
get_lora_ptr_dict: get a cached pointer tensor for LoRA weight tensors to avoid repeated data_ptr lookups
